paragraphs.text:
With a successful Navigate roll, you know where you are: go to 
234. If you fail the roll, you can wait for someone to pass by—go 
to 256. Or you can walk for a day—pick a direction: for East, go to 
278; for North, go to 277; for South, go to 269; for West, go to 257.
(94, 257, 269)
